title_zh: 用退货余额预留替代商品

scenario.label_zh: 使用店内余额换购物品
scenario.goal_zh: 核对店内余额并请店员预留替代商品。

context_zh: 顾客在虚构商店咨询退货所得店内余额，店员协助预留替代围巾，不涉及金融建议。
author: author-phase03-b

sentences.speaker: Customer Dario
sentences.text: I returned a scarf yesterday and received store credit. Can I use it for the blue one?

sentences.speaker: Shop Clerk Nia
sentences.text: Yes. I can see twenty pounds on your receipt, and the blue scarf costs the same.

sentences.speaker: Customer Dario
sentences.text: The clerk I spoke to yesterday said there might be one in the stockroom.

sentences.speaker: Shop Clerk Nia
sentences.text: I will check. If there is, I can hold it until tomorrow.

sentences.speaker: Customer Dario
sentences.text: Could you deal with the reservation for me? I need to leave soon.

sentences.speaker: Shop Clerk Nia
sentences.text: Certainly. There is one left, and I have put your name on it.

sentences.speaker: Customer Dario
sentences.text: Thank you. I will return tomorrow with the receipt.

targets.sense_zh: 退货后可用于店内购物的余额
